name: pole_orientation_agreement
summary: pole_quat: worst second_largest geodesic error 9.207e-02 rad exceeds 2.000e-03 rad; first violation at step 1

tolerance.rationale: The same budget as the joint angle, because for a rotation built from a single joint angle the geodesic angle between two orientations equals the difference in that joint angle. Setting it any looser would make the orientation oracle quietly weaker than the joint-space one that it is supposed to corroborate.
tolerance.scope: per-step geodesic angle between orientations, reduced over environments

name: termination_timing
summary: event 'termination': same occurrence pattern across 24 environments, worst timing delta 0 steps <= 1

tolerance.rationale: One control step is the finest resolution the workload has. A one-step timing difference is observable but explicitly permitted; two or more fails the event contract. Neither subject crosses the threshold in the nominal fixture.
tolerance.scope: absolute difference in the first step at which |angle| exceeds 1.2 rad

tolerance.rationale: This is the decision a user actually consumes from this workload, so any disagreement at all is operationally meaningful. With 24 paired environments the finest resolvable rate below 1.0 would be 0.958, so a weaker threshold would be a statement about the sample size rather than about the workload.
tolerance.scope: fraction of environments whose survive/terminate outcome agrees
